Seeded random test weights (seed 20261028) under the tensor names of
GLiNER2's DeBERTa-v3 encoder, reduced as provenance.json and docs/deberta.md
record. No value comes from a checkpoint. These are not production model
weights. Reference outputs produced by Hugging Face Transformers 4.57.1
(Apache-2.0) with bundle/reference/deberta/build_fixture.py.
